app_fee.value: No doctoral application fee is stated. Doctoral candidates are accepted by the faculty through HISinOne, and the official pages only list semester fees after acceptance.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver is stated on the official doctoral pages that were fetched.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on the official doctoral pages that were fetched; each faculty sets its own rules.

toefl_min.value: The official doctoral pages set no TOEFL minimum; the faculty regulations only ask for documented knowledge of German or English.

ielts_min.value: The official doctoral pages set no IELTS minimum; the faculty regulations only ask for documented knowledge of German or English.

english_waiver.value: No India or English-medium exemption is stated on the official doctoral pages that were fetched.

notes: Official list: six graduate schools (Environment, Society and Global Change; Humanities; Robotics; Hermann Paul School of Linguistics; Hermann Staudinger Graduate School (Chemistry and Pharmacy); Spemann Graduate School of Biology and Medicine). Faculty-level doctoral pages used for physics, math, chemistry, engineering and environment. Doctoral pages with a university-wide English or fee rule were not found; third-party aggregator figures (IELTS 6.5-7, TOEFL 90-100) were not used. Blocked or broken official pages: https://sgbm.uni-freiburg.de/node/29 (502 upstream, twice); https://www.sgbm.uni-freiburg.de/node/1847 (502 upstream, twice); https://sgbm.uni-freiburg.de/welcome-to-sgbm (502 upstream); https://www.math.uni-freiburg.de/nlehre/en/page/promotion/ (500 Internal Server Error).
